app.name: Chrono
app.tagline: Clients, projects, time and invoices in one place.

auth.signInLead: Chrono uses your Google account. No password to remember.
auth.failedBody: The link from Google expired or was already used. Start again.
auth.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not enabled on this Supabase project yet. Turn it on under Authentication, Providers, Google.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hoursPerDayHelp: Used to turn hours into days on day-rate projects.
settings.businessHelp: These details are copied onto an invoice when you issue it.
settings.taxProfileHelp: Decides which identifiers and legal mentions appear on your invoices.
settings.legalMentionsHelp: Printed in the invoice footer, word for word.
settings.invoicePrefixHelp: Numbers read {example}. Letters, digits and dashes only.
settings.paymentTermsHelp: Sets the due date when you create an invoice.
settings.dangerBody: This erases your clients, projects, time, leave and invoices. It cannot be undone, and accounting rules in France and Tunisia expect you to keep issued invoices for several years.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: Type {word} to confirm. Everything is erased straight away.

errors.prefixFormat: Use 1 to 12 letters, digits or dashes, such as INV or FA.
errors.hoursRange: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 24.
errors.termsRange: Enter a number of days between 0 and 365.
errors.loadFailed: This could not be loaded. Reload the page.
errors.notSignedIn: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rateRequired: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.notFound: This no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

clients.title: Clients
clients.empty: No clients yet. Add a client to start a project.
clients.name: Name
clients.currencyHelp: New projects for this client start with it.
clients.invoiceLanguageHelp: The language their invoices are written in.
clients.archiveHelp: An archived client stays on past invoices but is hidden from the lists.
clients.noProjects: No projects for this client yet.
clients.noInvoices: No invoices for this client yet.
clients.projectCount: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create a project to start logging time.
projects.emptyForClient: No projects for this client yet. Create one to start logging time.
projects.name: Name
projects.statusNoteHelp: Why the status changed. It shows in the history.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Create one from unbilled time or from manual lines.
invoices.unbilledFound: {count, plural, =0 {No unbilled time in this period} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
invoices.noUnbilled: No unbilled time for this client in this period. You can still create an empty draft and add lines by hand.
invoices.issueBody: It gets its number, its totals are recomputed and your details are copied onto it. After that it cannot be changed.
invoices.cannotIssueEmpty: Add at least one line before issuing.
invoices.lockedNotice: This invoice is issued, so it can no longer be changed.
invoices.reverseCharge: Reverse charge: VAT accounted for by the customer.
invoices.vatNotApplicable: VAT not applicable, article 293 B of the French tax code.
invoices.latePenalty: Late payment penalty: three times the statutory interest rate. Fixed recovery indemnity: 40 EUR.
invoices.numberClash: That invoice number is already used. The numbering counter is behind the invoices you already have; run npm run seed to line it up, or issue from a fresh year.

week.title: Week
week.empty: No active project. Create one to start logging time.
week.unbilled: Unbilled this week: {amount} across {clients, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}
week.cellHint: Type 2, 2h, 1h30 or 90m. On a day-rate project 0.5d also works.
week.leaveWarning: You have leave on this day. The entry was still saved.
week.pausedWarning: This project is {status}. Reactivate it to keep logging time.

leave.title: Leave
leave.empty: No leave recorded. Add leave so it shows in the week and is left out of working-day counts.

tasks.title: Task
tasks.empty: No task in this column yet.
tasks.boardEmpty: No task on this board. Add one to plan the work.
tasks.columnNotEmpty: Move or delete its tasks first.
